_comment: Latency budget per declared workload level, in milliseconds.
The rule (protocol 0.6, unchanged): healthy NO_OP per-event p99, rounded up
to the next 50 ms, measured on a dedicated calibration run at that level.
The healthy per-event latency distribution depends on offered load, so one
budget across levels would make Y measure the load rather than the failure.
